name: mulqi-better-harness
description: Native DeepSeek Harness plugin that publishes the better-harness review skill (explicit-only /better-harness gesture), its analysis CLI, and the resource trees the workflow needs.

scripts.test: node --test --test-reporter=tap tests/*.test.js > /tmp/mbh-test.out 2>&1; rc=$?; [ $rc -eq 0 ] || tail -n 40 /tmp/mbh-test.out; tests=$(grep '^# pass' /tmp/mbh-test.out 2>/dev/null | head -n 1 | awk '{print $3}'); [ -n "$tests" ] || tests=0; [ "$tests" -gt 0 ] || { echo 'FATAL: 0 tests ran — suite is empty or missing'; exit 1; }; node scripts/self-audit/integrity-execution-guard.mjs; grc=$?; [ $rc -eq 0 ] || { echo "FATAL: test suite failed (exit $rc) — see /tmp/mbh-test.out"; exit $rc; }; [ $grc -eq 0 ] || { echo 'FATAL: integrity execution guard failed'; exit $grc; }
